The 1 January 2020 unbundling moved Ukraine's transmission assets from Ukrtransgaz to GTSOU, so naming Ukrtransgaz on a row with StartYear1 2022 is stale. Ukrinform (19 October 2017) records GAZ-SYSTEM's own commissioning expectation for the interconnector and is staged as the project-status ref, not as an ownership source. This row is the named example in the Owner-attribution escalation; it is MEMO-ONLY there, and this is the row-level action that goes with it.
